1	-- scripts/pop_text_tick.lua
2	-- Easing functions, per-preset animation curves, and the per-tick update loop
3	-- for pop_text. The public presets and storage init live in scripts/pop_text.lua.
4	
5	local M = {}
6	
7	local math_sin = math.sin
8	local math_max = math.max
9	local math_min = math.min
10	
11	-- Reusable tables passed to the render API each tick (values are read
12	-- immediately by the engine, so reuse is safe).
13	local _pos = { x = 0, y = 0 }
14	local _col = { r = 1, g = 1, b = 1, a = 1 }
15	local _shd = { r = 0.04, g = 0.04, b = 0.04, a = 0.4 }
16	
17	-- ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
18	
19	local function resolve(id)
20	    local obj = id and rendering.get_object_by_id(id)
21	    return (obj and obj.valid) and obj or nil
22	end
23	
24	local function safe_destroy(id)
25	    local obj = resolve(id)
26	    if obj then obj.destroy() end
27	end
28	
29	-- ─── Easing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
30	
31	local function ease_out_quad(t)  return 1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t) end
32	local function ease_out_cubic(t) local u = 1 - t; return 1 - u * u * u end
33	
34	-- ─── Animation curves ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
35	-- Each returns: scale, alpha, dx, dy, orientation
36	-- orientation nil means "leave as is"; a number sets it (0-1 range).
37	
38	local function anim_spawn(entry, age, progress)
39	    local mul
40	    if     age < 5  then mul = 2.0 * ease_out_quad(age / 5)
41	    elseif age < 12 then mul = 2.0 - 1.0 * ((age - 5) / 7)
42	    else                 mul = 1.0
43	    end
44	    local dy    = -2.5 * ease_out_cubic(progress)
45	    local alpha = progress < 0.75 and 1 or (1 - (progress - 0.75) / 0.25)
46	    return entry.base_scale * mul, alpha, 0, dy, nil
47	end
48	
49	local function anim_team_join(entry, age, progress)
50	    -- Piecewise snap-in curve: rapid rise → overshoot relax → small bounce → settle
51	    local pop
52	    if     age < 4  then pop = 0.20 + 0.4125  * age
53	    elseif age < 10 then pop = 1.85 - 0.155   * (age - 4)
54	    elseif age < 16 then pop = 0.92 + 0.02167 * (age - 10)
55	    elseif age < 22 then pop = 1.05 - 0.00833 * (age - 16)
56	    else                 pop = 1.0
57	    end
58	    local dy = -4.0 * ease_out_cubic(progress)
59	    local jiggle_env = math_max(0, 1 - progress * 2)
60	    local dx    = 0.35 * jiggle_env * math_sin(age * 0.65)
61	    local alpha = progress < 0.60 and 1 or (1 - (progress - 0.60) / 0.40)
62	    return entry.base_scale * pop, alpha, dx, dy, nil
63	end
64	
65	local function anim_milestone(entry, age, progress)
66	    -- Comic elastic pop: snap → overshoot → bounce → settle
67	    local mul
68	    if     age < 6  then mul = 3.0  * ease_out_quad(age / 6)
69	    elseif age < 16 then mul = 3.0  - 2.1  * ((age - 6)  / 10)
70	    elseif age < 26 then mul = 0.9  + 0.75 * ease_out_quad((age - 16) / 10)
71	    elseif age < 35 then mul = 1.65 - 0.15 * ((age - 26) / 9)
72	    else                 mul = 1.5
73	    end
74	    local env = math_max(0, 1 - age / 35)
75	    local orientation = env * 0.035 * math_sin(age * 1.2)
76	    if orientation < 0 then orientation = orientation + 1 end
77	    local dy    = -1.5 * ease_out_cubic(progress)
78	    local alpha = progress < 0.75 and 1 or (1 - (progress - 0.75) / 0.25)
79	    return entry.base_scale * mul, alpha, 0, dy, orientation
80	end
81	
82	--- Snap in quickly, then keep growing gently across the whole life via
83	--- ease_out_cubic so the text feels like it's continuously inflating
84	--- while the rainbow cycles. No overshoot, no wobble, just smooth growth.
85	local function anim_global_milestone(entry, age, progress)
86	    -- Quick snap from small (0.5×) up to base over the first ~8 ticks.
87	    local snap_t = age < 8 and age / 8 or 1
88	    local snap   = 0.5 + 0.5 * ease_out_quad(snap_t)
89	    -- Continuous growth (+0.6× across full life) for the inflating feel.
90	    local grow   = 0.6 * ease_out_cubic(progress)
91	    local mul    = snap + grow
92	    local dy     = -2.0 * ease_out_cubic(progress)
93	    local alpha  = progress < 0.85 and 1 or (1 - (progress - 0.85) / 0.15)
94	    return entry.base_scale * mul, alpha, 0, dy, nil
95	end
96	
97	--- Convert a hue (0..1) to RGB at full saturation and value.
98	local function hsv_hue_to_rgb(h)
99	    h = h - math.floor(h)
100	    local seg = h * 6
101	    local i = math.floor(seg)
102	    local f = seg - i
103	    if     i == 0 then return 1,     f,     0
104	    elseif i == 1 then return 1 - f, 1,     0
105	    elseif i == 2 then return 0,     1,     f
106	    elseif i == 3 then return 0,     1 - f, 1
107	    elseif i == 4 then return f,     0,     1
108	    else               return 1,     0,     1 - f
109	    end
110	end
111	
112	local function anim_notify(entry, age, progress)
113	    -- Quick snap-in over 6 ticks; then hold in place; fade only at the end.
114	    local pop = age < 6 and (0.5 + 0.5 * ease_out_quad(age / 6)) or 1.0
115	    local dy    = -0.5 * ease_out_cubic(progress)  -- barely drifts; already near top
116	    local alpha = progress < 0.75 and 1 or (1 - (progress - 0.75) / 0.25)
117	    return entry.base_scale * pop, alpha, 0, dy, nil
118	end
119	
120	local function anim_rip(entry, age, progress)
121	    local mul
122	    if     age < 4  then mul = 3.5 * ease_out_quad(age / 4)
123	    elseif age < 10 then mul = 3.5 - 2.3 * ((age - 4) / 6)
124	    else                 mul = 1.2
125	    end
126	    local dy    = -4.5 * ease_out_cubic(progress)
127	    local alpha = progress < 0.65 and 1 or (1 - (progress - 0.65) / 0.35)
128	    return entry.base_scale * mul, alpha, 0, dy, nil
129	end
130	
131	-- ─── Tick ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
132	
133	function M.tick(now)
134	    local entries = storage.pop_texts
135	    if not entries or #entries == 0 then return end
136	
137	    local count = #entries
138	    local write = 1
139	
140	    for read = 1, count do
141	        local e        = entries[read]
142	        local age      = now - e.created_tick
143	        local progress = math_min(1, age / e.lifetime)
144	
145	        local text_obj = resolve(e.text_id)
146	
147	        if not text_obj then
148	            if e.shadow_ids then
149	                for _, sid in ipairs(e.shadow_ids) do safe_destroy(sid) end
150	            end
151	            goto continue
152	        end
153	
154	        if progress >= 1 then
155	            text_obj.destroy()
156	            if e.shadow_ids then
157	                for _, sid in ipairs(e.shadow_ids) do safe_destroy(sid) end
158	            end
159	            goto continue
160	        end
161	
162	        do
163	            local scale, alpha, dx, dy, orientation
164	            local at = e.anim_type
165	            if     at == "spawn"             then scale, alpha, dx, dy, orientation = anim_spawn(e, age, progress)
166	            elseif at == "team_join"         then scale, alpha, dx, dy, orientation = anim_team_join(e, age, progress)
167	            elseif at == "milestone"         then scale, alpha, dx, dy, orientation = anim_milestone(e, age, progress)
168	            elseif at == "global_milestone"  then scale, alpha, dx, dy, orientation = anim_global_milestone(e, age, progress)
169	            elseif at == "notify"            then scale, alpha, dx, dy, orientation = anim_notify(e, age, progress)
170	            elseif at == "rip"               then scale, alpha, dx, dy, orientation = anim_rip(e, age, progress)
171	            else
172	                text_obj.destroy()
173	                if e.shadow_ids then
174	                    for _, sid in ipairs(e.shadow_ids) do safe_destroy(sid) end
175	                end
176	                goto continue
177	            end
178	
179	            if scale < 1e-4 then scale = 1e-4 end  -- ease_out_quad(0)=0 on first tick
180	            _pos.x = e.anchor_x + dx
181	            _pos.y = e.anchor_y + dy
182	            text_obj.target = _pos
183	            text_obj.scale  = scale
184	            if e.rainbow then
185	                -- ~3 seconds per full hue cycle (180 ticks).
186	                local r, g, b = hsv_hue_to_rgb(age / 180)
187	                _col.r = r; _col.g = g; _col.b = b
188	            else
189	                _col.r = e.color_r or 1
190	                _col.g = e.color_g or 1
191	                _col.b = e.color_b or 1
192	            end
193	            _col.a = alpha
194	            text_obj.color = _col
195	            if orientation then text_obj.orientation = orientation end
196	
197	            local sids     = e.shadow_ids
198	            local soffsets = e.shadow_offsets
199	            if sids and soffsets then
200	                _shd.a = alpha * 0.6
201	                for i, sid in ipairs(sids) do
202	                    local s = resolve(sid)
203	                    if s then
204	                        s.scale = scale * 1.015
205	                        s.color = _shd
206	                        if orientation then s.orientation = orientation end
207	                        local off = soffsets[i]
208	                        if off then
209	                            _pos.x = e.anchor_x + dx + off[1]
210	                            _pos.y = e.anchor_y + dy + off[2]
211	                            s.target = _pos
212	                        end
213	                    end
214	                end
215	            end
216	        end
217	
218	        entries[write] = e
219	        write = write + 1
220	
221	        ::continue::
222	    end
223	
224	    for i = count, write, -1 do
225	        entries[i] = nil
226	    end
227	end
228	
229	return M

12	local force_utils = require("scripts.force_utils")
13	local helpers     = require("scripts.helpers")

18	-- pre_start can't require remote_api at the top level, and Factorio forbids a
19	-- runtime require inside a handler, so the hook is wired in at parse time.

26	-- and interact with mod panels. Everything game-world is blocked.

28	    "admin_action",
29	    "change_active_item_group_for_filters",
30	    "translate_string",
31	    "change_active_quick_bar",
32	    "change_multiplayer_config",

54	-- ─── Permission Group ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
55	
56	-- Called from control.lua on_init and on_configuration_changed.
57	function M.ensure_permission_group()
58	    local p = game.permissions.get_group(GROUP_NAME)
59	    if not p then p = game.permissions.create_group(GROUP_NAME) end
60	    -- Disable every defined game action.
61	    for _, action_id in pairs(defines.input_action) do
62	        p.set_allows_action(action_id, false)

97	-- ─── Commit (Start Playing) ───────────────────────────────────────────

99	-- Restore full permissions, start all clocks, clear pending state.
100	function M.commit(player)
101	    local force_name = player.force.name
102	    M.init_storage()
103	    storage.pre_start_pending[force_name] = nil
104	
105	    -- Restore every current team member to the Default group.
106	    local default = game.permissions.get_group("Default")
107	    if default then

109	        if force then

111	                if member.valid then default.add_player(member) end

116	    -- Start the team birth clock. raise on_team_clock_started exactly once,
117	    -- only when this commit is the call that actually stamps the start tick
118	    -- (the staged-start path defers the clock until this "Start Playing" click).
119	    storage.team_clock_start = storage.team_clock_start or {}

143	function M.cancel(force_name)

145	    storage.pre_start_pending[force_name] = nil
146	end

4	--
5	-- Shared first/fastest record tracking for any keyed event.
6	-- Used by tech_records (per technology) and milestones (per category:item:threshold).
7	--
8	-- Record structure:
9	--   records[key] = {
10	--     first   = { team, tick, elapsed, online_elapsed },
11	--     fastest = { team, tick, elapsed, online_elapsed },
12	--     entries = { [force_name] = { team, tick, elapsed, online_elapsed } }
13	--   }
14	--
15	-- `elapsed` is measured from the team's clock start (team birth), so a team
16	-- that joins the game later isn't penalized for absolute time. This is the
17	-- official basis for first/fastest awards.
18	-- `online_elapsed` is the team's accumulated online time at the moment of
19	-- completion (see scripts/team_clock.lua) — an alternate, schedule-fair ranking
20	-- the Awards GUI can sort by. May be nil on entries from saves predating it.
21	-- `entries` is keyed by force_name so each team is counted once per achievement;
22	-- the Awards GUI consumes this to render top-N leaderboards.
23	
24	local team_clock = require("scripts.team_clock")
25	
26	local records = {}
27	
28	--- Compute elapsed ticks since a team's clock started.
29	--- Returns nil if the team has no clock yet (shouldn't happen for claimed teams).
30	local function get_elapsed(force_name, tick)
31	    local clock = (storage.team_clock_start or {})[force_name]
32	    if not clock then return nil end
33	    return tick - clock
34	end
35	
36	--- Update first/fastest records for a given key.
37	--- Returns a result table describing what changed:
38	---   { is_first = bool, is_fastest = bool, previous_fastest = {team, tick, elapsed} or nil }
39	--- Note: when is_first is true, is_fastest is false (would be redundant to announce both).
40	function records.update(records_table, key, force_name, tick)
41	    records_table[key] = records_table[key] or {}
42	    local entry = records_table[key]
43	
44	    local elapsed = get_elapsed(force_name, tick)
45	    if not elapsed then return { is_first = false, is_fastest = false } end
46	    local online_elapsed = team_clock.online_ticks(force_name)
47	
48	    -- Backfill entries from first/fastest for saves created before the
49	    -- leaderboard tracking was added.
50	    entry.entries = entry.entries or {}
51	    if entry.first and not entry.entries[entry.first.team] then
52	        entry.entries[entry.first.team] = entry.first
53	    end
54	    if entry.fastest and not entry.entries[entry.fastest.team] then
55	        entry.entries[entry.fastest.team] = entry.fastest
56	    end
57	
58	    -- Record this team's completion (only the first time — second calls for
59	    -- the same team are no-ops; callers already dedupe per-threshold).
60	    if not entry.entries[force_name] then
61	        entry.entries[force_name] = {
62	            team = force_name, tick = tick,
63	            elapsed = elapsed, online_elapsed = online_elapsed,
64	        }
65	    end
66	
67	    -- First record for this key?
68	    if not entry.first then
69	        local rec = {
70	            team = force_name, tick = tick,
71	            elapsed = elapsed, online_elapsed = online_elapsed,
72	        }
73	        entry.first   = rec
74	        entry.fastest = rec
75	        -- Skip announcing "fastest" on the initial record (it's implied by "first")
76	        return { is_first = true, is_fastest = false }
77	    end
78	
79	    -- New fastest record? (Official ranking stays on server-elapsed.)
80	    if elapsed < entry.fastest.elapsed then
81	        local previous = entry.fastest
82	        entry.fastest = {
83	            team = force_name, tick = tick,
84	            elapsed = elapsed, online_elapsed = online_elapsed,
85	        }
86	        return { is_first = false, is_fastest = true, previous_fastest = previous }
87	    end
88	
89	    return { is_first = false, is_fastest = false }
90	end
91	
92	--- Return an array of all finishers for a record, sorted ascending by `field`
93	--- ("elapsed" = server time, the default; "online_elapsed" = team online time).
94	--- Entries missing the chosen field (saves predating online tracking) sort last,
95	--- tie-broken by server elapsed. Empty array if the record has no finishers.
96	function records.sorted_entries(record, field)
97	    field = field or "elapsed"
98	    local out = {}
99	    if not (record and record.entries) then return out end
100	    for _, e in pairs(record.entries) do out[#out + 1] = e end
101	    table.sort(out, function(a, b)
102	        local av, bv = a[field], b[field]
103	        if av == nil and bv == nil then return a.elapsed < b.elapsed end
104	        if av == nil then return false end
105	        if bv == nil then return true end
106	        if av ~= bv then return av < bv end
107	        return a.elapsed < b.elapsed
108	    end)
109	    return out
110	end
111	
112	return records

input.notes: Structural findings for the localisation plan. (1) helpers.lua is the message-fragment factory: team_display ("Team " prefix), team_tag, team_tag_with_leader (dim-bracket leader suffix), force_tag, colored_name, item_rich_name, tech_rich_name all return plain Lua rich-text fragments that callers concatenate into sentences across the whole mod — every announcement built through them is a server-side single-language string. Localising means converting these to LocalisedString builders or locale keys with placeholders. (2) The duration formatters fmt_duration / fmt_duration_coarse / format_elapsed hardcode English h/m/s unit suffixes via string.format and are reused by GUIs and chat in other files; they need locale-aware unit handling once, centrally. (3) global_milestones.announce() is a broadcast pipeline: one pre-built string goes to helpers.broadcast (player.print loop) AND pop_text.global_milestone (rendering.draw_text). Both APIs accept LocalisedString in Factorio 2.0, so the pipeline can carry a LocalisedString — EXCEPT the Discord bridge payload (remote_api.emit_to_bridge text field, line 146) which must stay a plain string; announcements that mirror to Discord need dual-format (LocalisedString for in-game + English plain string for the bridge). (4) pop_text.lua presets are display-agnostic — they render whatever text_str callers pass (use_rich_text=true); the only literal inside is "RIP!". Localisation work for pop text lives at the call sites. (5) helpers.tech_label (line 450) is the one locale-correct pattern in this batch: {"", localised_name, " ", level} composition — a model for the rest. (6) planet_map's logistic-rewrite notify shows raw internal surface variant names (mts-vulcanus-1) instead of display_surface_name — both a cosmetic and a localisation issue. (7) All pause/power and pause/wires diag strings sit behind file-local DIAG=false flags (visibility debug); helpers.diag and the plain log() calls are always-on but log-file only. (8) Files with zero display strings: scripts/pause/control.lua, scripts/pause/state.lua, scripts/pop_text_tick.lua, scripts/records.lua. records.lua sorts by numeric fields only (no sorted-by-text hazard).
